about.title: About
about.description: Anthony Rolland studies computer science and cybersecurity at INSA Hauts-de-France and focuses on back-end software engineering.
about.introduction: I’m Anthony Rolland, a 21-year-old engineering student at INSA Hauts-de-France, where I study computer science and cybersecurity.
about.summary: I’m interested in new technologies, especially software development. This portfolio brings together my skills, studies and the personal projects I build to keep learning.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Six projects by Anthony Rolland, from Java and Spring Boot APIs to file encryption and web development.

descriptions.rag: A Spring Boot REST API for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). It stores document embeddings in PostgreSQL with pgvector and answers queries using local Ollama models.
descriptions.picitApi: A REST API for the PicIt social network, built with Java and Spring Boot. It uses MongoDB and Neo4j.
descriptions.picitFront: The Next.js front end for the PicIt social network, written in TypeScript and styled with Tailwind CSS.
descriptions.fcrypt: A Java command-line tool built with Spring Shell to encrypt text, image, audio, and video files.
descriptions.clearLinks: Ethereum smart contracts on the Sepolia testnet for donations, voting, and creator support.
descriptions.rythmopolis: A website for a music events project, built with Angular and Tailwind CSS.
